dataset.description: Dataset will include experimentally measured nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectra of the synthesised intermediates and products. These spectra are instrumental for the structural characterisation of the synthesised compounds. The dataset will mainly contain 1H and 13C NMR spectra. Metadata, such as sample IDs, NMR spectrometer settings, solvent, temperature etc. will be included

dmp.description:
This Data Management Plan (DMP) is created for research application No. 1.1.1.9/LZP/1/24/090 "Development of Through-Space Charge Transfer Thermally Activated Delayed Fluorescence Emitters by Employing Carbene-Metal Molecular Frameworks" supported by Activity 1.1.1.9 "Post-doctoral Research" of the Specific Objective 1.1.1 "Strengthening research and innovative capacities and introduction of advanced technologies in the common R&D system" of the European Union's Cohesion Policy Programme for 2021-2027. The development of novel heteroleptic N-heterocyclic carbene (NHC) coinage metal (Cu, Ag or Au) complex thermally activated delayed fluorescence (TADF) emitters will be the main objective of this project. The metal-assisted TADF and through-space charge transfer TADF are two widely applied methods for designing highly efficient luminescent materials. In the scope of this project, we will combine these two methods. The metal-assisted through-space charge transfer TADF will be realized utilizing two different heteroleptic NHC complex structures – a linear structure and a molecular cage structure. Synthetic approaches to these complexes will be developed and the TADF emission will be characterized.
The purpose of the DMP is to outline the strategy for data collection, storing, and sharing at all the stages of research project implementation while ensuring compliance with the legal and ethical requirements. DMP will include experimental data arranged in 2 datasets regarding to structural characterisation of the newly synthesised intermediates and final products (nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectra) and photophysical property characterisation of newly obtained TADF materials (UV-Vis spectra, luminescence spectra, luminescence kinetics data).
